name: smwmusic-castlevania-chronicles-stage-clear
title: Castlevania Chronicles - Stage Clear
description:
The stage clear music from Konami's action game Castlevania Chronicles. Based on the Sharp X68000 version, which predates the PlayStation version released overseas. Could also fit game over.

This supports both the version with and without the goal whistle. If you want to turn it off, open the .txt file, look for the line "#define GoalPost 1", and change the number to '0'.
